versions.changelog: 升级到 2.0 版本：支持词库管理 (add/delete/list)、文件批量转换 (--input/--output)、兼容 1.0 简洁语法 (A/C 参数)、改进转换算法

- Initial release of Kazakh text converter skill.
- Supports bidirectional conversion between Cyrillic and Arabic scripts for Kazakh, including special characters.
- Handles multi-line text and automatic syntax correction.
- Compatible with Windows PowerShell.
- Includes command-line interface and usage documentation.
